_note: svelte2tsx throws on a `<slot>` whose `name` attribute is bare or a directive, and on a component child with a bare `slot` attribute; svelte-check then leaves the file out. `<slot name="">` is converted into an argument-less createSlot call, whose TS1135 is reported at the `<slot` and, being a syntax error, hides every semantic error in the program (the planted TS2322s here).
